criteria.description: AssessService returns survivability, available profiles, selected standby, replication freshness, standby health, and missing dependencies for one service.
AssessAll evaluates all managed services from profile and status read models in deterministic service-key order.
SimulateFailure excludes the failed worker from standby selection and recomputes survivability without mutating stores.
A profile is achievable only when standby assignment, worker capabilities, fresh replication policy, and healthy heartbeat are all satisfied.
